requirements.quote:
Any error detected by the BGP Finite State Machine (e.g., receipt of
   an unexpected event) is indicated by sending the NOTIFICATION message
   with the Error Code Finite State Machine Error.
requirements.condition: Any error is detected by the BGP Finite State Machine, including receipt of an unexpected event.
requirements.error_behavior: Send a NOTIFICATION message with Error Code Finite State Machine Error.
requirements.why_checkable: The FSM error path can be inspected and exercised to verify that it sends a NOTIFICATION carrying the specified Error Code.
